title: Fix Azure blob storage pagination infinite loop causing OOM
body:
In AzureObjectStorage::listObjects(), the loop body was re-calling client_ptr->ListBlobs(options) without a continuation token, overwriting the paginated response and re-fetching the first page on every iteration. When >1000 files exist under a prefix (e.g. Iceberg /metadata), this caused an infinite loop accumulating duplicate results until OOM.

The for-loop already handles pagination correctly via MoveToNextPage(), so the redundant ListBlobs call is simply removed.

Also removes a redundant unused ListBlobs call in AzureIteratorAsync that was doubling every Azure list API request.
